recipes.Dockerfile.app:
FROM knowhub-sourceid-test/app:runtime-8ae91bc44
COPY artifacts/WeKnora /app/WeKnora
COPY artifacts/sourceid-enroll /app/sourceid-enroll
COPY source/migrations /app/migrations
COPY source/config /app/config
COPY source/scripts/docker-entrypoint.sh /app/scripts/docker-entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /app/WeKnora /app/sourceid-enroll /app/scripts/docker-entrypoint.sh
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.revision="2fcbcaaedfa75fb955bd44dd7fe464ded64eec7c" knowhub.environment="sourceid-business-isolated"

RUN mkdir -p /work/cache/go/pkg/mod/github.com/yanyiwu && cp -a /go/pkg/mod/github.com/yanyiwu/. /work/cache/go/pkg/mod/github.com/yanyiwu/

COPY artifacts/sourceid-binding /app/sourceid-binding
RUN chmod +x /app/sourceid-binding

USER root
RUN chmod -R a+rX /app/config /app/migrations
recipes.Dockerfile.frontend:
FROM knowhub-sourceid-test/frontend:8ae91bc44
RUN rm -rf /usr/share/nginx/html/*
COPY artifacts/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY source/frontend/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/templates/default.conf.template
COPY source/frontend/nginx-api-proxy.conf /etc/nginx/api-proxy.conf
COPY source/frontend/nginx-http.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/00-weknora-http.conf
COPY source/frontend/docker-entrypoint.sh /docker-entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /docker-entrypoint.sh
LABEL knowhub.environment="sourceid-business-isolated"

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.revision="2fcbcaaedfa75fb955bd44dd7fe464ded64eec7c"
